name: Red Lobster Wood-Grilled Rainbow Trout (Plain, No Butter Sauce)
whyItWorks: Fresh, delicate freshwater trout grilled over wood fire. Flakes delicately under a fork, offers marine omega-3s, and has zero rough connective tissue or fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Wood-Grilled Rainbow Trout plain—NO seasoned butter brush, NO garlic glaze, grilled with sea salt only.' Pair with plain baked potato or plain rice.
